# Menu

Navigate hierarchical commands, open submenus, and invoke an action.

## Examples

### Project commands

Run common project commands from one flat command list.

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Arrow Up</kbd> / <kbd>Arrow Down</kbd> | Move between items at the current menu level. |
| <kbd>Arrow Right</kbd> / <kbd>Arrow Left</kbd> | Open a submenu or return to its parent. |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> | Move to the first or last item at the current level. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Open a submenu or invoke the current item. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Close the current menu level. |

## Accessibility

Menu items, separators, and nested menu state use hierarchical menu semantics and roving focus.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menubar/) for the host accessibility contract.
